case_metadata.title: Morbi Ceramics Cluster vs Crop Stubble Burning Confounder
case_metadata.description: Demonstrates heavy agricultural stubble fires 1.4 km outside factory zones. System uses landcover, wind, and baseline envelopes to classify as AGRI_BURN rather than industrial disaster.

telemetry_steps.description: VIIRS detects 24.5 MW hotspot 1.4 km from Morbi ceramic kilns. Potential confounder triage initiated.
ESA WorldCover cropland verification and downwind smoke drift confirm agricultural stubble burning outside industrial bounds.
